q1_issues.issue: the harvested salt-bloom is the bare kind constant salt_bloom in a dated episodic clause, while the anaphoric definite "The salt-bloom" two sentences later mints sk_salt_bloom_1 — the specific stuff harvested and the stuff that came off the stones end up as two unconnected symbols.

(LocatedIn sk_stones_1 sk_pool_1) encodes the of-genitive "the stones of the second pool" as spatial containment, but LocatedIn is licensed only for in/at/inside/within; a genitive takes PartOf (part/component) or the opaque Possession.
(Measure sk_harvest_1 duration 1 night) supplies a magnitude no word states and uses "night", a day-part constant, in the unit slot, where units are lemmatized measure nouns (hour, day, year).

q2_gaps: "on day 33 of Year 1" — an epoch-relative day-of-year date; the Time terms have no day-of-year slot and (Day 33) is out of range for the day-of-month reading (Day) otherwise carries

"at the new-moon spring tide" — an event-noun as a temporal anchor under "at": the Time value slot is specified for structured calendar terms and deictic/named constants, and the ordering machinery covers only before/after/during, so nothing licenses an event witness as a Time value
"took the whole night" — a duration stated as a whole named period with no number and no unit noun; (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) has no form for it

a NEGATED past perfect ("The two southern pools had not bloomed", after the inspection event): the anteriority rule presumes an asserted perfect event to order, and says nothing about whether a Before atom is emitted for a denied one, or whether it would sit inside or outside the strength-0 bundle

an Ordinal on an entity with no associated event or "-est" dimension ("the second pool"): the scale slot is defined as the associated event or an explicit dimension, and here the parse has to fall back on the kind symbol pool
notes: Plural handling is otherwise strong: definite/bare plurals all take group witnesses with per-member distribution rules for the descriptive modifiers (submerged, pale, southern), the collective singular "harvest party" correctly does not distribute, inspect takes Theme, and the negated plural keeps both the group denial and the strength-0 member rule.
